# env/overlay/lib/daemon

## Overview
Python 3 package implementing Antigravity's background task scheduler and execution runtime invoked by `agy-daemon`. Combines an adaptive scheduler loop (`2`s active / `8`s idle) with DNS config guarding and cached user conversation turn monitoring (`scheduler.py`), event triggers and an authenticated loopback HTTP webhook server (`triggers.py`), and a bounded worker pool that executes shell commands or dispatches AI prompts directly to `language_server` via ConnectRPC (`executor.py`), re-exported through `__init__.py`.

## Interface
- `[__init__.py:__all__]` Re-exports `matches_cron`, `parse_duration`, `daemon_loop`, `check_github_repo`, `check_file_watcher`, `check_battery_condition`, `start_webhook_listener`, `log`, `notify`, `wake_antigravity_app`, `execute_action_async`, `load_tasks`, `save_tasks`, `CONFIG_DIR`, `TASKS_FILE`, `LOG_FILE`, `PID_FILE`, `STOP_EVENT`, `TASK_EXECUTOR`, `RUNNING_JOBS`, and `RUNNING_LOCK`.
- `[executor.py:CONFIG_DIR]` Runtime path and execution constants: `PREFIX`, `HOME`, `AGY_APPLICATION_ID`, `RISH_BIN`, `BASH_BIN`, `CONFIG_DIR` (`<HOME>/.gemini/antigravity-app/daemon`), `TASKS_FILE`, `LOG_FILE`, `PID_FILE`, `STOP_EVENT`, `LANGUAGE_SERVER_SERVICE` (`exa.language_server_pb.LanguageServerService`), `CORTEX_TRAJECTORY_SOURCE_CASCADE_CLIENT` (`1`), `LOOPBACK_HOSTS`, `TASK_EXECUTOR`, `RUNNING_JOBS`, `RUNNING_LOCK`.
- `[executor.py:execute_ai_prompt]` Core executor functions: `application_id_from_prefix(prefix=None)`, `get_core_state_path()`, `log(msg)`, `_resolve_gateway_config()`, `_post_gateway_notification_direct(...)`, `notify(title, message, tag=None, channel=None, cascade_id=None)`, `load_tasks()`, `save_tasks(tasks)`, `wake_antigravity_app()`, `load_core_state(state_path=None)`, `execute_ai_prompt(prompt, project='', conversation_id='', timeout_sec=60, state_path=None)`, and `execute_action_async(task)`.
- `[scheduler.py:daemon_loop]` Scheduler functions and paths: `RESOLV_CONF_PATH` (`<HOME>/etc/resolv.conf`), `BRAIN_GLOB`, `_is_user_conversation(path, state)`, `_discover_transcript_paths(state, brain_glob=None)`, `_extract_conv_id(path)`, `_turn_tag_for_path(path)`, `_check_conversation_turns(state, brain_glob=None)`, `read_daemon_pid()`, `parse_duration(s)`, `matches_cron(cron_expr, dt=None)`, and `daemon_loop()`.
- `[triggers.py:start_webhook_listener]` Trigger evaluators and webhook server: `check_github_repo(trigger_info, endpoint_type='pulls')`, `check_file_watcher(trigger_info)`, `check_battery_condition(trigger_info)`, and `start_webhook_listener(port)` (`LocalWebhookServer` + `WebhookHandler`).

## Invariants
- `[executor.py:save_tasks]` Persists `TASKS_FILE` atomically by writing `TASKS_FILE + '.tmp'` and calling `os.replace`, invalidating `_TASKS_CACHE`; `[executor.py:load_tasks]` caches deep-copied task lists keyed by `(TASKS_FILE, st_mtime_ns, st_size)` under `_TASKS_CACHE_LOCK`.
- `[executor.py:TASK_EXECUTOR]` Bounds concurrent worker threads to `max_workers=4`; `[executor.py:execute_action_async]` skips overlapping runs for any `task['id']` present in `RUNNING_JOBS` (guarded by `RUNNING_LOCK`).
- `[executor.py:load_core_state]` Returns `(None, '', state)` when `state['ready']` is explicitly `False` or both `base_url` and `https_port` are missing; `[executor.py:_build_ssl_context]` disables TLS verification exclusively for hosts in `LOOPBACK_HOSTS` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`).
- `[executor.py:execute_ai_prompt]` Clamps ConnectRPC timeouts to `[5, 120]`s, skips `StartCascade` when `conversation_id` is non-empty, and raises `RuntimeError` if core is unavailable or no cascade ID is returned.
- `[executor.py:_run_task_worker]` Runs prompt-only tasks via ConnectRPC with zero shell interpolation and falls back to argv-list `notify()` (`success=False`) on error; `notify()` accepts optional `cascade_id`, attempts direct `POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/gateway` first (reading `gateway.token` under `HOME`), and falls back to `agy-notify` CLI (forwarding `--tag`, `--channel`, and `--cascade-id`) when absent/unreachable; command tasks take precedence over prompt with default `timeout_sec=600` using `BASH_BIN` (else `/system/bin/sh`), capping persisted `last_output` at `1000` chars.
- `[scheduler.py:_guard_resolv_conf]` Rewrites `RESOLV_CONF_PATH` atomically whenever `1.1.1.1` is absent or `timeout:1 attempts:1` is present, preserving other existing `nameserver` entries.
- `[scheduler.py:_read_last_jsonl_record]` Limits transcript tail reads to `65536` bytes from EOF; `[scheduler.py:_discover_transcript_paths]` caches `BRAIN_GLOB` expansion by `brain/` `(st_mtime_ns, st_size)` with a `30.0`s max refresh interval; `[scheduler.py:_check_conversation_turns]` skips `os.stat` for cached non-user transcripts (`user_convo_cache[path] is False`), filters out subagent transcripts via `_is_user_conversation`, extracts sanitized `cascade_id` via `_extract_conv_id(path)`, tracks `(st_mtime_ns, st_size)` changes, seeds baseline steps on first scan without notifying, and notifies at most once per `step_index` on `PLANNER_RESPONSE` (`status=='DONE'`) using per-conversation tag `_turn_tag_for_path` on channel `"agy_alerts"` with `cascade_id` for both `"Task Complete"` and `"Input Needed"`.
- `[scheduler.py:matches_cron]` Requires exactly 5 whitespace-separated fields and maps Python `weekday()` to cron `dow` (`0=Sun..6=Sat`) via `(dt.weekday() + 1) % 7`.
- `[scheduler.py:daemon_loop]` Evaluates only `enabled=True` tasks, disables `once`/`delay` and `battery` tasks upon firing, throttles `cron` to once per minute (`int(now // 60)`), spawns at most one daemon thread per webhook port (default `45199`), adapts tick interval (`2`s when `working_convos` is non-empty or an active `watch_file`/trigger with `interval_sec <= 15` is enabled, else `8`s), and unlinks `PID_FILE` on exit only if `read_daemon_pid() == os.getpid()`.
- `[triggers.py:check_github_repo]` and `[triggers.py:check_file_watcher]` Record baseline state on first observation without firing and trigger only on strict increases (`current_count > last_count` / `curr_mtime > last_mtime`).
- `[triggers.py:start_webhook_listener]` Binds `127.0.0.1:<port>` only, accepts only `POST /`, caps `Content-Length` to `MAX_BODY_BYTES=65536` (`400`/`413`), and authenticates header `X-AGY-Token` against enabled tasks' non-empty `trigger['token']` via `hmac.compare_digest` (`401` otherwise).

## Side Effects
- `[executor.py:log]` and `[executor.py:save_tasks]` Create `CONFIG_DIR`, append to `daemon.log`, write stdout, and atomically replace `tasks.json`.
- `[executor.py:_connect_rpc_call]` Sends HTTP(S) POST requests to `<base_url>/exa.language_server_pb.LanguageServerService/{StartCascade,SendUserCascadeMessage}` with `Connect-Protocol-Version: 1` and optional `x-codeium-csrf-token`.
- `[executor.py:_run_task_worker]` Executes task shell commands via `subprocess.run(..., shell=True)`, posts notifications directly to `SystemGatewayServer` or via `agy-notify` (`[executor.py:notify]`), optionally launches the Android app via `rish`/`am` (`[executor.py:wake_antigravity_app]`), and persists run metadata back to `TASKS_FILE`.
- `[scheduler.py:_guard_resolv_conf]` Atomically rewrites `<HOME>/etc/resolv.conf`; `[scheduler.py:_check_conversation_turns]` reads `transcript.jsonl` files for user conversations and posts per-conversation `agy_turn_*` alerts; `[scheduler.py:daemon_loop]` spawns webhook threads and unlinks `PID_FILE` on shutdown.
- `[triggers.py:check_github_repo]` Issues HTTPS GET requests to `https://api.github.com/repos/<repo>/<endpoint_type>?state=open` (timeout `15`s) and mutates `trigger_info`; `[triggers.py:check_file_watcher]` stats filesystem paths; `[triggers.py:check_battery_condition]` runs `rish -c 'dumpsys battery'` (timeout `5`s); `[triggers.py:start_webhook_listener]` binds a local TCP port and dispatches matched tasks via `execute_action_async()`.

## Verification
- Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s env/tests -v`
- Run: `bash env/build.sh assets && bash env/tests/invariant`
